shared_protocol.independent_first_pass: Assign narrow independent tasks against one frozen input snapshot hash; submit initial conclusions before revealing other conclusions.
shared_protocol.evidence_packet: Versioned JSON Schema. Classify each claim as CONFIRMED_FACT, SOURCED_CLAIM, INFERENCE, SPECULATION, UNKNOWN or DISCONFIRMED; include source IDs, timestamps, source independence, assumptions, support and disconfirming evidence.
shared_protocol.source_independence: Syndicated copies of one release count as one source. Record shared ownership/data providers and copied wording as dependencies.
disagreement_resolution: Rank directness, source quality, methodology, freshness, reproducibility and independence; do not use majority vote.
Require an independent reviewer to challenge the strongest hypothesis.
Retain minority objections and disconfirming evidence.
If unresolved, mark UNRESOLVED and block affected features/forecasts.
shared_protocol.red_team: A reviewer other than the task author challenges assumptions, base rates, source dependence, leakage and alternate causal explanations. NOT_RUN until an actual review packet exists.
shared_protocol.verified_handoff: Record input/output SHA-256, source IDs, auth state, permission scope, UTC time, tests/CI links, errors and explicit DESIGNED/EXECUTED/VERIFIED status.
shared_protocol.least_privilege: Public read by default. Repository writes only to reviewed branch/PR changes; no merge, deployment, private-data or trading permission is granted by this architecture.
shared_protocol.rate_limit_fallback: Use deterministic local validation and aged public snapshots. Provider failures become UNAVAILABLE, never zero or fabricated confidence.
shared_protocol.live_collaboration_rule: No platform is marked connected until authenticated request/response, scope review, data-flow test and verifiable handoff exist.
